summary: All 4 security fixes VERIFIED. SEC-002 (boot guard): confirmed by temporarily setting JWT_SECRET='change-me-please', restarting backend, observing 'RuntimeError: JWT_SECRET is a weak/placeholder value — refusing to start' in backend.err.log, then restoring the original secret and confirming /api/ returns 200. SEC-001 (admin seed): admin login for copperstone17@gmail.com with ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD env value succeeds and returns is_admin=true; server.py contains NO hard-coded admin password literal (only the parent-supplied password, the env-derived admin_pw, and seed-tutor 'password123' which is expected). SEC-003 (Stripe webhook): with STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET empty, POST /api/stripe/webhook returns 503 without a signature and 400 with a bogus signature; a forged webhook targeting a real pending booking's payment_intent_id did NOT flip its payment_status. SEC-004 (files ACL): child photos referenced in parents.children[].avatar_url are 200 for the owning parent, 401 anonymous, 403 for a different parent; a generic upload (not referenced by any child) remains 200 unauthenticated (public tutor images unaffected). REGRESSION: parent prv@test.dev login OK, /api/bookings/me returns list, seeded tutors present (Sofia found), tutor signup with non-@babybabel.dev email survives (validated by re-login after signup — seed_data() only wipes @babybabel.dev tutors not in KEEP_EMAILS). Icon regression: /app/frontend/assets/images/babybabel-icon.png is exactly 669627 bytes; metro serves it at /assets/assets/images/babybabel-icon.png with HTTP 200. Pytest: 12/12 on security suite (serial run); the parallel first run had 4 transient 502s during backend cool-down after the SEC-002 restart — re-run serially = green.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L472: `oauth2_scheme` has `auto_error=False`; the private-file branch correctly falls back to the ?token query param, but note only the header-based Bearer token is exercised by mobile clients. If a future feature needs image URLs pastable in , allow the ?token= querystring path (already implemented) — good defensive design.
server.py is still ~1320 lines; earlier iteration recommendation to split into modules still stands but is not blocking.

The transient 502 during backend startup is a known cold-start artifact (motor/index creation + emergent storage init). Test suite should include a health-check gate; consider adding a `wait_for_backend` autouse fixture that pings /api/ until 200 before the first test.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 security-suite; 19/19 with existing bookings suite when run serially)
success_rate.frontend: icon asset served OK (200, 669627 bytes); functional UI regression deferred — backend flows already verified via API in previous iteration and remain green

seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral TEST_parentA_<hex>/TEST_parentB_<hex>/TEST_tutor_public_<hex>/TEST_survivor_<hex> accounts via /api/auth/signup during test runs. Data is prefixed 'TEST_' per convention and can be cleaned by wiping @test.dev and @example.com signups if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 security fixes and the icon regression are verified. If you re-run the full backend suite, prefer serial (-n0) or add a warmup step — parallel xdist immediately after a backend restart can hit 502s during motor index creation. The `test_no_hardcoded_admin_password_literal` scan is intentionally narrow (checks for 'REDACTED' / 'admin' literals inside hash_password calls) — future admin-password rotations must keep going through ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD env var.
rca_of_issue: No open bugs. Note on the transient parallel-run failure: pytest-xdist with 2 workers hit the backend at t≈2s post-restart while motor was still creating indexes and emergent storage was initializing (see startup() in server.py L1293-1306). Serial re-run and warmup ping both pass. Recommendation: add a session-scoped autouse fixture in conftest.py that polls /api/ until 200 (max 30s) before dispatching tests.
